properties.description: Hike turf trails through open restored native prairie past the historic Tanyard building, where the Shakers tanned leather and pumped water to the Water House located beside Centre Family Dwelling.
properties.name: Tanyard

properties.description: Mostly turf trails take you through open restored native prairie, wood lots and farm ponds, where a variety of wildlife viewing opportunities lie around every bend.
properties.name: Meadow View

properties.description: Start north along the paved road to West Lot and The Stable. Cross the bridge, follow Shawnee Run Creek to the right, and you will quickly see large American Sycamore trees with white bark and skeletal look of the upper branches.
properties.name: Towering Sycamores

properties.description: Hike southwest along the Historic Turnpike, past the remains of Shaker grist and linseed oil mills. Cross Kissing Bridge and observe the remains of the dam once used to provide water for the mills downstream.
properties.name: Heritage

properties.description: Trail blazed in white. Traverse woodland trails and turf in the open prairie, then view the Fulling Mill site (the most photographed waterfall, flowing at its highest during winter snow melts and spring rains), an extremely  scenic overlook of Shawnee Run
properties.name: Shawnee Run

properties.description: Follow the gravel road north until the trail turns to turf and takes you to an overlook of the restored native prairie bordered by woodland to the north and east.

properties.description: The Helen C. Black Trail, opened in 2020, is located in the John and Marion Becker Cedar Falls Preserve. Part of the Edge of Appalachia Preserve System, it features a 15-foot limestone cascade best viewed in spring or after heavy rain.
properties.name: Helen C. Black Trail

properties.description: Buzzardroost Rock Trail in Ohio's Edge of Appalachia Preserve leads to a limestone monument 300 feet above Brush Creek valley, offering spectacular views. The trail features rare prairie plants, while turkey and black vultures are often seen at the rock.
properties.name: Buzzardroost Rock Trail

properties.description: Lynx Prairie Trail offers a peaceful hike through woods and prairie, featuring blue-stem and rare three-awn grasses. Home to fritillaries and swallowtails, it includes cedar barrens and grassland spots. Named a National Natural Landmark in 1967.
properties.name: Lynx Prairie Trail
